segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/combination skin found it oily but non-clogging and glow-giving, while another warns it is not suited to combination or oily skin especially in humidity; one reviewer states it would not be a good sunscreen for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as moisturizing, soft-feeling, and non-drying, with one calling it perfect for dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report no white cast issues and no pilling with other products, though one found the amount needed for full coverage excessive on combination/oily skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no reaction, calming and soothing effects and recommend it as a sensitive-skin holy grail, while others describe allergic reactions, rashes, burning sensation, or redness and dryness specifically on the face.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions using it as part of an anti-aging routine alongside a retinoid, noting no stickiness or greasy feel despite increased photosensitivity.

concerns.aging: One reviewer using a retinoid (linked to photosensitivity) found this sunscreen non-greasy and comfortable for daily use as sun protection in an anti-aging routine.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as moisturizing, soft, or soothing on dry/dehydrated skin, with none reporting it worsened dryness.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say it calmed or reduced redness (from exfoliation or general sensitivity, including rosacea), but two reviewers report new redness, rash, or a burning sensation after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or eczema-prone skin generally report no issues, but a few describe allergic reactions or rashes suggesting barrier irritation for some users.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports zero breakouts and praises it as non-comedogenic; another with oily/combination skin also says it does not clog pores.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers with oily or combination skin like the natural glow and non-greasy finish, while others explicitly warn it is unsuitable for oily skin or leaves a heavy, sweaty, non-drying-down feel.

extraits.texte: I got this sunscreen because it has less chemicals than other sunscreens being mineral based. I went to the beach for 2.5 hours and applied 3 seperate times. The sunburn I have is unreal!! I'm born and raised in Florida, and a sunscreen has never dissapoitned me more than this one. It's a very thick consistency so it's hard to rub in fully. I didn't mind because I thought I'd be more protected from the sun. Not the case. It feels as if I didnt use any sunscreen at all.

I really wanted to love this sunscreen and was so excited to try it but unfortunately my skin did not take well to it. Thankfully, I had just used it on my arms and neck so when I broke out into a rash on these areas, I knew it was because of the sunscreen. I gave it two stars because it blended very nicely and didnt leave a white cast but it just wasnt for me. I have rosacea and very sensitive skin overall so it may just be me, but definitely do a spot test before you use it all over.

So i really do like this sunscreen. Its very comfortable, doesnt have a white cast, and didnt pill in combination with my other products. I found this to be MUCH better than the whipped foam sunscreen that blew up on tiktok. The only reason i am giving this 4 stars is because the skin on my face is incredibly sensitive so i got red, irritated and dry after using this on my face for a few days. I know its no fault of the product though because my neck and body didn't have a reaction. I would say definitely give this a try it was one of the most comfortable and user friendly mineral sunscreens ive ever tried! If you have hypersensitive skin then i would skip.

extraits.titre: Great for Sensitive Skin and Actually Works!
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin but this sunscreen has caused 0 problems! It also leaves the most minimal white cast (if any really) of all the brands I've tried, which is double the amazing because it's zinc oxide level is 20%. It is a heavier, but I just don't use moisturizer beforehand (very combo skin) and kind of like the glow it leaves :) After a long boat day, can vouch for it's waterproofness too. But it will turn white if you sweat a lot and it wipes off on clothes, but its a physical sunscreen, so that makes sense.

When it comes to mineral sunscreens, I have tried alot of them. Last summer, I would have said Native sunscreen was my favorite. But I love this!!! I love how moisturizing it is, particularly because I have dry skin. This is a repurchase for sure. (Yes, only 15.5% zinc oxide.)

My skin has been red from over exfoliating. When i put this on it reduces the redness and makes my skin look great! I feel i dont need muxh makeup after. The ingredients are great and it works so well to calm skin. Being a mineral sunscreen is the icing on the cake!

extraits.titre: Amazing Zinc Sunscreen for the Price
extraits.texte: Entirely transparent zinc sunscreen (it doesn't leave a white cast) and it is supremely hydrating. This wouldn't be a good sunscreen for oily skin, but it is perfect for dry skin. I don't have that chalky feeling at the end of the day, and I love that it is fragrance free.
